
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /stress  (/adversarial)                    │
  │  Adversarial Code Review                    │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Run adversarial stress testing on your code.

  Usage:
    /stress
    /stress <file>

  Details:
    Stress testing tries to break your code by finding edge cases,
    security vulnerabilities, performance issues, and logic errors.
    Can target a specific file or run on the whole project.

  Examples:
    $ /stress
    $ /stress src/api/routes.py

  Related: /complexity  /archaeology
